principal_mechanism: Proof-carrying context composition of free-state accounting certificates, with coherent common-leaf reduction and whole-operation induction
strict_reduction: The first symbolic compilation target is sources whose complete paired trees have at most three vertices after iterative simultaneous common-leaf pruning at every original operation boundary. Physical support, source length, target population, hanging subtrees, repetitions and interleavings remain unbounded. This is a stated restricted domain, not an assertion that all sources satisfy the bound.
constructive_reason: Common-leaf deletions commute. A common complete hanging subtree can be removed by these deletions. On KEEP into one such subtree, the identical internal double prefixes in A and B cancel with cost one-to-one; at most two internal path vertices remain. DELETE into such a subtree has path length bounded by the final core because the path to the new A root survives pruning in unchanged B. Thus the target operation reduces to a complete finite transition on at most six retained vertices, with arbitrary physical hanging subtrees carried intact.
bounded_scope: One context compiler, one exact free-function quotient teacher, one symbolic compression proof, one bounded complete-source and original-U audit. Do not automatically invent another potential feature family. Test and retain counterexamples to context erasure, classify rather than conceal unsupported core expansion.
upward_connection: A successful compiler discharges global frame/resource sharing and cyclic cancellation on the explicitly recognized bounded-core class. It does not discharge unrestricted core expansion. Before claiming any enlarged residual payment, audit literal original U IDs and compare with the elementary target-depth comparison law. A redundant theorem must be labeled redundant.

frozen_trial.coefficient_objective: any finite rational C >= 1, exact inequalities on every retained transition
frozen_trial.state_function_family: unrestricted table on canonical reduced paired core states; no frontier coefficients

excluded_restarts: another frontier threshold or roots guard
acceptance: A finite table is only a component. The source-uniform restricted result additionally requires the explicit arbitrary-subtree compression proof and a checked closed telescope. The original universal root remains OPEN unless arbitrary core sizes are proved.
prior_files: All earlier research remains read-only. All new artifacts, caches and logs stay in this versioned directory.
